## Use

Read [shared theme guidance](../GUIDANCE.md) before using this reference.
Use this file with one selected slug from [CATALOG.md](../CATALOG.md).

## Brand

shadcn style design

## Style foundations

- Visual style: minimal, clean
- Typography scale: 12/14/16/20/24/32 | Fonts: primary=Geist, display=Geist,
  mono=Fira Code | weights=100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600, 700, 800, 900
- Color palette: primary, secondary | Tokens: primary=#000000,
  secondary=#111111, success=#16A34A, warning=#D97706, danger=#DC2626,
  surface=#FFFFFF, text=#111827
- Spacing scale: 4/8/12/16/24/32

## Copy tone

- Tone: concise, confident, helpful.

## Design intent

Shadcn/ui-inspired design with minimal, clean components, monochrome palette,
and utility-first patterns.
